candidates.summary: the blank-button guards miss siblings of their own fixtures: a label of only format characters and an href that is blank after decoding both render a live button
candidates.failure_scenario: invalid_label_blank_after_decode and hostile_label_bidi_zero_width ('Only invisible') pin that a label showing nothing is no label, but buttonLabel strips only the StripBidiAndZeroWidth set (U+200B-200F, U+202A-202E, U+2066-2069, U+FEFF) plus Cc controls. label="⁠" (word joiner), "؜" (Arabic letter mark, the bidi mark beside LRM/RLM), "­" (soft hyphen), "ㅤ" or "⠀" each renders \u2060 etc., a blank button. Likewise invalid_empty_attributes pins href="" and href=" " rejected, but the check at line 72 reads the raw bytes: href=" " renders space href and href=" " renders href="%C2%A0", a button to a dead relative path
candidates.verify_by: render through NewGnoExtension under the production goldmark options (render_config.go) the inputs <gno-button href="/r/test" label="⁠" />, label="؜", label="­", <gno-button href=" " label="x" />: expect <!-- raw HTML omitted --> as for label=" " and href="", observe a rendered <a class="gno-button">. Fix stays off the native set (consensus): drop unicode.Cf runes in buttonLabel and test len(bytes.TrimSpace(resolveDestination(t.href))) == 0
